name: Welrod
source: Shiki Kan’s personal bodyguard, she came into play right after the move to Tanegashima. Socially inept, she uses delusional fantasies to handle stress, embarrassment and anxiety while interacting with others. Has been employed as Shiki’s bodyguard for two weeks.
